content: The One-Step Strategy recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) involves conducting a 75-gram oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT). This test requires the patient to fast beforehand. After consuming the glucose solution, plasma glucose levels are measured at fasting, one hour, and two hours post-consumption. This procedure is typically performed between the 24th and 28th weeks of gestation in pregnant women who have not been previously diagnosed with diabetes.
